Possible.description: Initial resting state. Touch points and initial timestamps are cached into tracking structures. Cumulative movement is tested against spatial/temporal gates without mutating view state.

Began.description: Continuous gesture recognized. Movement threshold exceeded or ballistic interruption occurred. Competitor subview touches cancelled unless simultaneous recognition is granted.

Changed.description: Continuous interactive update state. Touch displacement, velocity, scale, or rotation updates view state on each digitizer scan tick.

Ended.description: Terminal recognized state. For continuous gestures, touch contact has lifted; release velocity is computed. For discrete gestures (Tap/Swipe), gesture recognition is fully satisfied.

Cancelled.description: Terminal interrupted state. Aborted by external hardware interrupt, system edge gesture preemption via _UISystemGestureGate, incoming telephone call, or parent view takeover.

Failed.description: Terminal failure state. Input sequence violated recognition constraints (e.g. wander > 10pt before tap up, duration > 250ms, direction mismatch, or delegate veto). Unblocks failure dependents.

transitions.predicate: euclidean_distance(p_curr, p0) >= touchSlopThreshold && _gestureRecognizerShouldBegin == YES && failureRequirementsSatisfied == YES
side_effects: Cancels subview touches via -[UIView touchesCancelled:withEvent:] if cancelsTouchesInView == YES

transitions.predicate: duration <= maxTapDuration (250ms) && distance <= allowableMovement (10pt) && tapCount == numberOfTapsRequired && failureRequirementsSatisfied == YES
side_effects: Dispatches discrete target-action with state Ended (Recognized)
Triggers state reset on next runloop cycle
Cancels competing pans in same hierarchy

transitions.predicate: distance > allowableMovement (for Tap) || duration > maxTapDuration || directionMismatch == YES || [delegate shouldBegin] == NO
side_effects: Unblocks waiting gestures in failure dependency DAG
Inserts sample into velocity ring buffer
Evaluates rubber-band bounds resistance if applicable
Evaluates final release velocity vector via OLS regression over ring buffer
Clears dragging flags without ballistic momentum fling
Animates resting spring return if resting outside valid bounds
Resets directional lock state to LockAxisNone
Clears touch array and restores state to Possible (0)

arbitration_rules.failure_dag_evaluation: Topological sorting over UIGestureGraph; recognizer A remains in Possible with _isPendingRecognition=YES until all required recognizers enter Failed state.
arbitration_rules.system_gesture_priority: System-level edge gestures (Back swipe, Notification Centre, Control Centre, Reachability) register directly in SpringBoard / _UISystemGestureGate, hold touch delivery via delaysTouchesBegan=YES, and preempt userland recognizers unconditionally.

priority_ordering.name: System Edge Gestures (SpringBoard Gate)
priority_ordering.preemption_behavior: Unconditional hardware preemption; holds userland touches via _UISystemGestureGate; cancels active app gestures upon edge commitment.

priority_ordering.name: Screen Edge Recognizers
priority_ordering.preemption_behavior: Captures touches initiating in the 15-20pt display bezel inset; delays internal viewport pan recognition.

priority_ordering.name: Modal & Content Interrupters
priority_ordering.preemption_behavior: Preempts underlying content touches when pull-down dismissal vector is initiated.

priority_ordering.name: Direct Subview Userland Recognizers
priority_ordering.preemption_behavior: Evaluated in inverse Z-order (deepest subview first). If child recognizer begins, cancels ancestor touches unless simultaneous recognition is granted.

priority_ordering.name: Container Scroll Views & Paging Controllers
priority_ordering.preemption_behavior: Delays content touches by 150ms via UIScrollViewDelayedTouchesBeganGestureRecognizer; if touch slop (10pt) is exceeded, cancels subview touches and claims exclusive drag.
